newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, JAN 6-SUNDAY, JAN 12.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, JAN 6-SUNDAY, JAN 12.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
THE HAGUE - European Commission meeting with EU Dutch Presidency (Tuesday).
FRANKFURT - European Commissioner de Silguy attends European Monetary Insitute council (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday).
MONDAY, JANUARY 6
BRUSSELS - European Commissioners Brittan and Monti meet Canadian National Revenue Minister Jane Stewart.
THE HAGUE - European Commissioner Van Miert addresses the Europa Club.

THE HAGUE - The Party of European Socialists led by MEP Pauline Green meets Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, European Affairs Seretary Michiel Patijn, Social Affairs Minister Ad Melkert, Environment Minister Margreeth de Boer and Justice Secretary Elisabeth Schmitz. MEP Pauline Green and Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok hold joint news conference at 1830/1730 GMT. European Commissioner Cresson also attends. Venue: Foreign Affairs Ministry.

BRUSSELS - Assembly of Western European Union's new president, Luis Maria de Puig, meets WEU General Secretary Jose Cutileiro and WEU Council members (to January 7). Venue: Hotel Astoria, rue Royale 103, 1000 Brussels. Contact: Yves Robins (33 1 53 67 22 00).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - French National Assembly President Philippe Seguin gives lecture (2030/1930 GMT) on "Nations, Europe and Globalisation". Venue: Grande Salle du Palais des Congres, Coudenberg 3. Contact: Grandes Conferences Catholiques, c/o Matire Emile Vergrubben, avenue de la Renaissance 34, 1000 Brussels.
TUESDAY, JANUARY 7
THE HAGUE - European Commission meeting with EU Dutch Presidency. News conference at 1500/1400 GMT.
THE HAGUE - European Commissioner van den Broek gives national horticulture companies award.
FRANKFURT - European Commissioner de Silguy attends European Monetary Insitute council.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 8
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0900/0800 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioners Brittan, Bangemann and van den Broek communication on textile accords with Russia.
- Orientation debate on the inter-governmental conference and general framework for a draft treaty.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 9
BRUSSELS - European Commissioners Van Miert, Pinheiro, Monti, Fischler, de Silguy, Wulf-Mathies and Bonino meet French Overseas Minister Delegate Jean-Jacques de Peretti.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Pinheiro meets Commonwealth Secretary General Emeka Anyaoku.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Papoutsis meets French Parliament gas rapporteur Bernard Derosier.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Fischler meets European Rural Owners Organisation.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament members, European Commission and Council of Ministers officials meet European Platform for Patients' Organisations, Science and Industry (1030/0930 GMT) on "Patenting of biotechnology inventions in the EP". Venue: European Parliament, Room Belliard 61, rue Belliard 97-113, 1040 Brussels. Contact: European Platform for Patients' Organisations, Science and Industry, rue Franklin 108, 1000 Brussels (322 735 8188).
TOULOUSE, France - European Commissioner Kinnock visits Airbus factory.
FRIDAY, JANUARY 10
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Fischler meets COPA Chairman David Naish.
NORWAY - European Commissioner van den Broek on official visit; meets Norwegian Prime Minister Thorbjorn Jagland and Foreign Minister Bjorn Godal.
ROME - European Commissioner Monti meets Italian Interior Minister Giorgio Napolitano.
